## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the issue and affected
journey document/scenario when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and any checks that could not run. Include demo screenshots
for visible changes and update the affected user-journey document.

## Dependencies and attribution

Identify new dependencies or copied/adapted material and their licenses. Write
"None" when this does not apply. Do not include credentials or private content.

Original contributions follow AGPL-3.0-only as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Preserve existing notices and identify separately licensed material.
